p3.en: Scan the QR code to watch the video introduction to this chapter.

p4.original: 从受精卵一直走到生命的终点，我们会经历婴儿期、儿童期、青春期和成年期。遗传和环境在这个过程中是如何持续地对我们产生影响的？在出生时，我们具有哪些能力？婴儿期的哪些影响因素会对我们产生长期的作用？在不同时期，我们会面临哪些发展任务？青春期是一个混乱的阶段吗？中年之后，我们就开始走下坡路，直到面临死亡这一终点吗？本章将从4个核心概念出发，为你讲解心理学研究人员发现的那些关于人的发展的知识。
p4.en: From fertilizing eggs to the end of life, we go through infancy, childhood, adolescence and adulthood. How does genetic and environmental influence continue to affect us in this process? What are our abilities at birth? What are the factors that affect childhood that will have a long-term impact on us? What development tasks do we face at different times? Is adolescence a stage of chaos? After middle-aged years, have we begun to go downhill until the end of the road to death? This chapter will be based on four core concepts, which will explain to you the knowledge of human development found by psychologists.

p5.original: 阅读完本章后，你将会了解遗传为人类的发展做了哪些准备，又设置了哪些遗传约束。先天和后天因素如何共同作用以帮助儿童习得语言、获得必要的认知能力和社会交往能力。虽然青少年会因为身体变化、认知变化和社会情绪压力等面临各种发展挑战，但是总体而言青春期并不是一个动荡的阶段。成年也并不意味着进入了一个稳定的平台期，随着生活发生变化人们将面临一系列转变。中年是一个人一生中很多方面发展的高峰期，甚至某些能力到晚年还可以持续发展。除此之外，在本章中，你还将了解一些较为前沿的心理学研究，如注意缺陷/多动障碍（ADHD）的最新研究及其积极的一面、科学家如何看待当代社会中“男孩日渐没落，女孩愈加性感化”这一现象以及相应的应对策略。你甚至还可以获取一些有趣的知识，如玩到底有什么作用、莫扎特效应的真实性等。
p5.en: After reading this chapter, you'll know what genetic preparations are made for human development and what genetic constraints are set. How congenital and acquired factors work together to help children learn their language, acquire the necessary cognitive and social skills. Although adolescents face development challenges due to physical, cognitive and social stress, adolescence is not a volatile phase in general. Nor does adulthood mean entering a stable platform period, with people facing a series of transformations as life changes. Mid-life is the peak of many aspects of human development in a lifetime, and even some capabilities can be sustained in later years. In addition, in this chapter you will also be familiar with the more cutting-edge psychological studies, such as the latest study on the Attention to Impairments/Multiple Barriers (ADHD) and its positive aspects, how scientists perceive the phenomenon of “boys falling and girls becoming more sexy” in contemporary society, and the corresponding coping strategies. And you can even get some interesting knowledge about what it's like to play, what it's like to play, what it's like to be real about the Mozart effect.

p6.original: 作者把埃里克森的社会心理发展的8个阶段贯穿整章，使我们不仅可以了解每一个年龄阶段的发展任务，也可以了解不同阶段之间的联系。本章还将遗传和环境的作用贯穿于每一个阶段，使我们了解人生发展的两股最强大力量是如何相互作用推动人们一路向前的。
p6.en: The author's comprehensive chapter of eight stages of Eriksson's psychosocial development allows us to understand not only the development mandate of each age stage, but also the linkages between the different stages. This chapter also brings the role of genetic and environmental effects through every stage, and gives us an idea of how the two most powerful forces of human development interact to drive people forward.

p7.original: 个体发展不只是从婴儿到成年人的短短20年，它是贯穿一生的一个过程。通过阅读本章你将会获得一份独一无二的人生说明书。不论你现在处于人生的哪一个阶段，相信本章的内容都将为你的生活提供一些有益的帮助。
p7.en: Individual development is not just about 20 years from baby to adult, but it is a life-long process. By reading this chapter, you'll get a unique statement of life. Whatever stage of your life you are at, it is believed that the content of this chapter will provide some useful help in your life.

p9.original: 浙江理工大学心理学系副教授
p9.en: Associate Professor, Department of Psychology, Zhejiang University of Technology

p10.original: 生理（遗传）和环境（养育）是如何共同作用从而塑造每一个个体的？即使是同卵双胞胎也不是真的完全相同。
p10.en: How does the biological (genetic) and environmental (rearing) function together to shape each individual? Even identical twins are not really identical.
